rationale: The prompt's central requirement is Object-detection training code. The anchored # bitsandbytes - LLM Quantization scopes the source-visible material to Quantizes LLMs to 8-bit or 4-bit for 50-75% memory reduction with minimal accuracy loss. Use when GPU memory is limited, need to fit larger models, or want faster inference. Supports INT8, NF4, FP4 formats, QLoRA trainin, which does not provide a plausible route to that central input/output boundary.
